title: Google Cloud: Dialogflow default mTLS client certificate (new default)
summary: The legacy Google Trust Services certificate remains available only as a temporary fallback until December 1, 2026; update your server's trust store (and any certificate subject allowlists) to trust SSL.com Root Certification Authority RSA before that date

name: Google Cloud
symbol: Cloud DNS responses to QTYPE=ANY queries in public zones
title: Google Cloud: Cloud DNS responses to QTYPE=ANY queries in public zones (behavior change)
summary: Starting January 5, 2027, Cloud DNS will disable full responses to DNS queries of type ANY (QTYPE=ANY) in public authoritative zones
replacement: Query specific record types separately; use resourceRecordSets.list, gcloud dns record-sets list, or the Console to retrieve full zone records.

name: Google Cloud
symbol: DNS queries of type ANY in public authoritative zones
title: Google Cloud: DNS queries of type ANY in public authoritative zones (behavior change)
summary: Starting January 5, 2027, Cloud DNS will disable full responses to DNS queries of type ANY (QTYPE=ANY) in public authoritative zones
replacement: Query specific record types individually, or use resourceRecordSets.list, gcloud dns record-sets list, or the Console to retrieve full zone records

name: Google Cloud
symbol: Cloud DNS CNAME chasing across public and private zones
title: Google Cloud: Cloud DNS CNAME chasing across public and private zones (behavior change)
summary: Starting January 5, 2027, CNAME chasing behavior will change so that Cloud DNS follows CNAME chains between public and private zones
replacement: Review CNAME chasing needs, test DNS query paths with dig or nslookup, and configure matching TTLs for records in CNAME chains.

name: Google Cloud
symbol: CNAME chasing between public and private zones
title: Google Cloud: CNAME chasing between public and private zones (behavior change)
summary: Starting January 5, 2027, CNAME chasing behavior will change so that Cloud DNS follows CNAME chains between public and private zones
replacement: Review CNAME chasing paths and configure matching TTL values for records in the CNAME chain

name: Google Cloud
symbol: Cloud DNS full responses to ANY queries in public zones
title: Google Cloud: Cloud DNS full responses to ANY queries in public zones (behavior change)
summary: Starting January 5, 2027, Cloud DNS will disable full responses to DNS queries of type ANY (QTYPE=ANY) in public authoritative zones
replacement: Query specific record types individually, and use the Cloud DNS REST API (resourceRecordSets.list), gcloud dns record-sets list, or the Google Cloud Console to retrieve full zone records.
